reuse.why: Puts the rule in the existing shouldWriteMonthBudget predicate, but detects the tag with a lowercase substring match instead of the shared extractTagsFromText in #shared/tags.

duplication.why: The same LEFT JOIN notes and group_notes column are pasted into six separate category queries (getBudgetData, setZero, setLastMonthSpending and the three averages) instead of one shared category query.

placement.why: The tag rule sits in the shared write predicate in budget/actions.ts, where the hidden and template rules already are; only the data plumbing is spread across the actions.

scope.why: Besides the #fixed rule, it adds g.hidden AS group_hidden to the three average queries, which changes how they treat hidden groups and was not asked for.

maintainability.why: Adding another exclusion means editing six queries again, and the substring match ('#fixed' inside '#fixedcosts', in any case) disagrees with how the app parses tags elsewhere.

bypasses_abstraction.where: budget/actions.ts shouldWriteMonthBudget: group_notes.toLowerCase().includes('#fixed') instead of extractTagsFromText from #shared/tags

disguised_duplication.where: the repeated join is a plain copy in each query, not disguised

one_place.where: budget/actions.ts shouldWriteMonthBudget is the single predicate every month-wide action uses; each action's query still has to supply group_notes on its own
